entities.name: Nikola, Crown Prince of Montenegro

entities.summary: Nicholas, Prince of Montenegro, is a French-born architect and the Head of the House of Petrović-Njegoš, which reigned over Montenegro from 1696 to 1766 and again from 1782 to 1918.
